verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents a REST API for triggering deployments, creating preview deployments, embedding the assistant, exporting analytics and managing docs programmatically. An admin MCP server also gives AI tools write access to content and dashboard settings, including editing pages, updating settings and opening PRs. Content itself is Git-backed, so much of what the UI does can be done programmatically, but nothing states that every UI action is available through the API. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity guarantee, documented API coverage of dashboard features such as SSO/RBAC, domains, editor review/merge and automations configuration, a discoverable public OpenAPI spec (the probe found none), and independent hands-on corroboration.
